title: Specs first: features/daw/mix.feature and its steps
description:
## Intent

Write the M3 specs first and watch them fail.

## Steps

- `features/daw/mix.feature` from the M3 stories (mixer, devices, sidechain, left-out settings, master); steps added to `features/daw/STEPS.md` and `crates/apricity-daw/tests/daw.rs`.
- Device Then steps read parameters in the score's units (dB, Hz, ms, %) through one conversion table shared with the implementation's tests, so a step never hard-codes a normalized value.

## Verification

`CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw --test daw` runs the new scenarios; each fails for missing behavior; list them in a comment.

## Release

`test(<this task's id>): specs for the mix in DAW sets`, or folded into the first M3 feat commit.
